from glom.mutation import Assign, assign, PathAssignError


# Backward compatibility: expose constants under 'constants' module attribute
class _Constants(object):
    """Container for glom module-level constants."""
    __slots__ = ('SKIP', 'STOP', 'OMIT', 'ROOT')
    
    def __repr__(self):
        return '%s(SKIP=%r, STOP=%r, OMIT=%r, ROOT=%r)' % (
            self.__class__.__name__, self.SKIP, self.STOP, self.OMIT, self.ROOT)


constants = _Constants()
constants.SKIP = SKIP
constants.STOP = STOP
constants.OMIT = OMIT
constants.ROOT = ROOT
